p-h-hamiltonian-definition: Section II.A, p.3: the paper defines H^p/h with Eq. 9 and the normal-ordering Nb; Phi0 is its reference state. Read in context.
new-vacuum-hf-slater-determinant: Section II.A, p.3, Eq. 4: the paper defines the new vacuum |Phi0> as the product of creation operators for the N occupied orbitals and says it equals the HF Slater determinant.
quasi-particle-definition: Section II.A, p.3: the paper names holes and particles relative to |Phi0> quasi-particles and defines their operators in Eqs. 5-8.
p-h-transform-choice-hamiltonian-side: Section II.A, p.3: the paper states its own design choice (transform the Hamiltonian, not the wavefunction) and its stated reason.
scope-uccsd-only: Section II.B.1, p.4: the paper restricts itself to T = T1 + T2 (UCCSD) and states why higher orders are left out. It is its own scope statement.
three-entangler-blocks-defined: Section II.B.2, p.5, Eqs. 19-20 and Fig. 2: the paper defines the three entangler blocks it tests (U1,ex, U2,ex, all-to-all CNOT).
number-penalty-term: Section II.B.2, p.5, Eq. 21: the paper defines the penalty term mu(N-N0)^2 added to the p/h Hamiltonian and says it can be switched on gradually. It is a method the paper defines, not a result.
vqe-initial-angles-uniform: Section III, p.6, step (iii): the paper states the initial angle distribution of its own procedure.
vqe-optimizer-bfgs: Section III, p.6, steps (ii) and (v): the paper states Jordan-Wigner and BFGS as its own choices.
setup-6-31g-h2-h2o: Section IV, p.6 and IV.B.1, p.7: 6-31G for all calculations, H2 has 8 HF orbitals (2 occupied, 6 virtual), H2O has Nmax = 12. All three facts are in the text.
setup-oxygen-ecp-8-valence-electrons: Section IV, p.6: the paper states it replaced oxygen 1s core electrons with ECPs, leaving 8 valence electrons.
heuristic-convergence-setup-1e-7: Section IV.A, p.7: D is raised until convergence to chemical accuracy; optimizer stops at < 1e-7 Ha between iterations; 'Equil' is at about 0.7 A. All three are the paper's own protocol.
truncation-error-definition: Section IV.B.2, p.9 and Table II: the paper defines E_diag minus E_UCCSD(an) (exact exponentiation) as its measure of the second-order truncation error.
trotter-test-single-geometry-h2: Section IV.B.2, p.9: the paper states the test is at one geometry (0.592 A) with E_diag as reference. This is the test's setup (basis setup, not stated limit; no limit is stated). The outcomes are not claimed here.
fig6-fig7-block-counts: Figure 6 and 7 captions, p.10: D = 8 for H2 and D = 20 for H2O, as quoted.

theory_low.appendix-a-commutators-vanish: Appendix A, p.13: the claim that [A,B] and the nested commutators vanish is stated without the calculation, and 'similarly for the double excitation terms' is not shown. Stated not proved.
theory_low.appendix-a-first-order-trotter-steps: Appendix A, p.13: a derivation step with no error analysis. Eq. AA.5 reads the same as Eq. AA.4 in the text, so the 'once more' step is not shown. The paper's Trotter error result is measured (Fig. 5), not proved.
